body.zh-Hant: 溫萊特1883年8月23日生於華盛頓州瓦拉瓦拉，1906年畢業於西點軍校，第一次帶兵是在德州邊境的一支騎兵部隊。他在45年的軍旅生涯中多次駐防德州的要塞，1938年前已逐級晉升為准將。
body.en: Wainwright was born at Walla Walla, Washington, on 23 August 1883. He graduated in 1906 and took his first troop command with a cavalry unit on the Texas border. During forty-five years of army service he was stationed at Texas forts, and by 1938 he had risen to brigadier general.

heading.zh-Hant: 菲律賓戰役與科雷吉多爾

body.zh-Hant: 1940年10月，溫萊特奉派到菲律賓，在麥克阿瑟麾下任職。菲律賓戰役艱苦持續數月；麥克阿瑟離開巴丹後，指揮權交給中將溫萊特。榮譽勳章嘉獎令寫明，他自1942年3月12日至5月7日指揮美國陸軍在菲律賓的部隊，以堅毅果決的領導對抗兵力遠勝的敵軍。科雷吉多爾島於1942年5月6日投降，他被日軍俘虜。
body.en: In October 1940 Wainwright was assigned to duty in the Philippines under General Douglas MacArthur. The battle for the Philippines was hard fought and lasted several months. When MacArthur left Bataan, command passed to Lieutenant General Wainwright. His Medal of Honor citation records him commanding United States Army Forces in the Philippines from 12 March to 7 May 1942, with intrepid and determined leadership against greatly superior forces. Corregidor was surrendered on 6 May 1942 and he was taken prisoner.

body.zh-Hant: 溫萊特在日本戰俘營度過三年半。二戰結束後他返回美國，獲頒榮譽勳章，並於1945年9月晉升四星上將。1946年1月他受命指揮設於聖安東尼奧薩姆休士頓堡的第四集團軍，1947年8月31日自該職退役；1953年9月2日在聖安東尼奧的布魯克陸軍醫療中心去世，以軍禮葬於阿靈頓國家公墓。
body.en: Wainwright spent three and a half years in Japanese prison camps. After the war he returned to the United States, was awarded the Medal of Honor, and was made a full general in September 1945. He was assigned command of the Fourth Army at Fort Sam Houston, San Antonio, in January 1946 and retired from that command on 31 August 1947. He died at Brooke Army Medical Center on 2 September 1953 and was buried with full military honors at Arlington National Cemetery.

body.zh-Hant: 李海1875年5月6日生於愛荷華州漢普頓，1897年畢業於海軍官校，被分派到戰艦奧勒岡號，在艦上服役到美西戰爭結束。1899年他以少尉身分被派往亞洲艦隊，參與鎮壓菲律賓叛亂與義和團事件。1904年返美後，他在巡洋艦波士頓號與加利福尼亞號服役，擔任過海軍官校教官，也任駐尼加拉瓜美軍指揮官的參謀長。
body.en: Leahy was born at Hampton, Iowa, on 6 May 1875 and graduated from the Naval Academy in 1897. Assigned to the battleship Oregon, he served in her through the Spanish-American War. In 1899 Ensign Leahy went to the Asiatic Station and took part in suppressing the Philippine Insurrection and the Boxer Rebellion. After returning home in 1904 he served in the cruisers Boston and California, was an instructor at the Naval Academy and chief of staff to the commander of U.S. forces in Nicaragua.

heading.zh-Hant: 海軍作戰部長、總督與大使
heading.en: Chief of Naval Operations, governor and ambassador

body.zh-Hant: 1937年1月，李海出任海軍作戰部長，任期兩年多，期間遠東與歐洲局勢日趨緊張，海軍則逐步擴充；他經常兼任代理海軍部長。1939年8月退役後，他被任命為波多黎各總督；1940年底成為美國駐法國大使，任職到1942年4月。
body.en: In January 1937 Leahy became Chief of Naval Operations, serving for more than two years while tensions rose in the Far East and Europe and the Navy gradually expanded; he often had additional duty as Acting Secretary of the Navy. After retiring in August 1939 he was appointed Governor of Puerto Rico. In late 1940 he became United States Ambassador to France, serving until April 1942.

body.zh-Hant: 返國後，李海被召回海軍服役，擔任羅斯福總統的助手與參謀首長聯席會議的資深成員，在第二次世界大戰的戰略、外交與執行上扮演關鍵角色。1944年12月他晉升海軍五星上將。羅斯福1945年4月去世後，他繼續輔佐杜魯門，直到對德、對日最終勝利，並協助戰後初期的施政；他1949年退休，但技術上到1959年7月20日去世時仍在現役。
body.en: On returning home Leahy was recalled to Navy service as Aide to President Roosevelt and Senior Member of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, playing a critical role in the strategy, diplomacy and execution of the Second World War. He was promoted Fleet Admiral in December 1944. After Roosevelt's death in April 1945 he continued in his posts under President Truman through final victory over Germany and Japan and into the early postwar years. He retired in 1949 but technically remained on active duty until his death on 20 July 1959.

body.zh-Hant: 米切爾出生於法國尼斯，家族是威斯康辛的鐵路與銀行世家。他在美西戰爭時以十九歲之齡入伍，後獲晉升中尉；1901年成為正規陸軍通信兵團的中尉，1916年被任命為通信兵團新設航空科的主管。
body.en: Mitchell was born in Nice, France, into a Wisconsin railroad and banking family. He enlisted in the Spanish-American War at nineteen and was promoted to lieutenant; in 1901 he became a regular army lieutenant in the Signal Corps, and in 1916 he was appointed chief of the Corps' new aviation section.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰與聖米耶勒
heading.en: The First World War and St. Mihiel

body.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰中，米切爾以准將身分在法國組建並指揮美國陸軍剛成立的航空勤務隊。1918年9月，他規劃並指揮聖米耶勒戰役中全戰爭規模最大的空中作戰，統轄近1,500架盟軍飛機；他也試驗大規模轟炸敵軍陣地與設施，在與英國皇家飛行隊首長特倫查德爵士的討論後，成為空權的倡導者。
body.en: In the First World War Mitchell, as a brigadier general, organized and led the Army's fledgling Air Service in France. In September 1918 he planned and commanded the largest air operation of the war at St. Mihiel, with nearly 1,500 Allied aircraft under his control. He also experimented with mass bombing of enemy formations and installations and, after discussions with Sir Hugh Trenchard, head of the Royal Flying Corps, became a champion of airpower.

heading.zh-Hant: 空權倡議與轟炸艦艇試驗
heading.en: Airpower advocacy and the ship-bombing tests

body.zh-Hant: 停戰後，米切爾回到美國，以航空勤務隊助理主管的身分主導陸軍航空事務。1921至22年間，他的飛機在維吉尼亞角外海的預定試驗中擊沉被俘軍艦；1923年9月5日，他的轟炸機從他在哈特拉斯附近建的臨時機場出擊，在外海擊沉弗吉尼亞號與新澤西號兩艘戰艦。
body.en: After the Armistice Mitchell returned to the United States and, as Assistant Chief of Air Service, shaped Army aviation. In 1921-22 his planes sank captured warships in prearranged tests off the Virginia Capes. On 5 September 1923 his bombers, operating from a temporary airfield he built near Hatteras, sank the battleships Virginia and New Jersey off the coast.

body.zh-Hant: 1925年3月，米切爾的航空勤務隊副手任期未獲續任，他因此失去准將軍階。其後他公開指責陸海軍領導人，被以不服從上級的罪名交付軍事審判，判處停職五年；他選擇辭職，於1926年離開陸軍。他1936年2月去世，享年五十六歲。
body.en: In March 1925 Mitchell's tenure as Air Service deputy was not renewed and he lost his star. After publicly accusing Army and Navy leaders he was court-martialed for insubordination and suspended for five years; he chose to resign, leaving the Army in 1926. He died in February 1936 at the age of 56.

body.zh-Hant: 西姆斯（1858–1936）1880年畢業於安納波利斯海軍官校。美西戰爭期間他擔任駐巴黎的海軍武官，負責組織情報活動以回報西班牙艦艇的動向；其後他倡導改進射擊術，推廣英國人珀西·斯科特爵士的技術。
body.en: Sims (1858-1936) graduated from Annapolis in 1880. During the Spanish-American War he served as naval attache in Paris, organizing espionage to report Spanish ship movements. Later he advocated improved gunnery, popularizing the techniques of the Englishman Sir Percy Scott.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次世界大戰：駐歐美國海軍
heading.en: The First World War: U.S. naval forces in Europe

body.zh-Hant: 1917年3月，擔任海軍戰爭學院院長的西姆斯被派往倫敦，協調海軍在第一次世界大戰中的角色，後來成為美國駐歐洲水域海軍部隊總司令。他看出必須以反潛作戰對抗德國的無限制潛艇戰，建議建造反潛艦艇部署到歐洲水域，在昆士敦的路易斯·貝利爵士等英國將領麾下服役。
body.en: President of the Naval War College when he was sent to London in March 1917 to coordinate the Navy's role in the First World War, Sims later became commander in chief of U.S. naval forces in European waters. He saw the need for antisubmarine operations against Germany's unrestricted undersea warfare and recommended building antisubmarine craft and deploying them to European waters under British admirals such as Sir Lewis Bayley at Queenstown.

body.zh-Hant: 戰後，西姆斯批評海軍部的努力遲緩而方向錯誤，引發國會對海軍事務的調查。1920年他出版記述戰時經歷的《海上的勝利》，該書獲普立茲獎。
body.en: After the war Sims argued that the Navy Department's effort had been slow and misdirected, which sparked a congressional inquiry into naval affairs. In 1920 he published The Victory at Sea, an account of his wartime service, which won the Pulitzer Prize.

body.zh-Hant: 李傑特（1857–1935）生長於賓州雷丁，1879年6月13日畢業於西點軍校，晉升為第5步兵團少尉。1899年12月至1901年10月他在菲律賓指揮達沃分區。1909年7月至1910年7月他在陸軍戰爭學院受訓，畢業後進入參謀部並任學院主任，1912年3月起擔任學院院長。
body.en: Liggett (1857-1935), born and raised in Reading, Pennsylvania, graduated from West Point on 13 June 1879 and was commissioned second lieutenant in the 5th Infantry. From December 1899 to October 1901 he commanded the Sub-District of Davao in the Philippines. He was a student at the Army War College from July 1909 to July 1910, then a General Staff member and director of the college, and from March 1912 its president.

body.zh-Hant: 1913年2月12日李傑特晉升准將。1914年5月1日至11月1日，他在德州城指揮第2正規師第4旅；其後在菲律賓指揮臨時步兵旅，1916年4月15日起指揮菲律賓部，至1917年4月15日；1917年5月14日至9月15日，他在舊金山指揮西部部。
body.en: Liggett became a brigadier general on 12 February 1913. From 1 May to 1 November 1914 he commanded the 4th Brigade, 2nd Regular Division, at Texas City. He then commanded a Provisional Infantry Brigade in the Philippines, led the Department of the Philippines from 15 April 1916 to 15 April 1917, and commanded the Western Department at San Francisco from 14 May to 15 September 1917.

heading.zh-Hant: 第1軍：馬恩河、聖米耶勒與阿爾貢
heading.en: I Corps: the Marne, St. Mihiel and the Argonne

body.zh-Hant: 1917年9月他受命指揮第41師，10月6日抵達法國；1918年1月20日轉任第1軍軍長。7月4日至8月13日第1軍隸屬法國第6軍團參加第二次馬恩河戰役，其後在聖米耶勒攻勢中，9月12日開始行動並於9月16日結束；馬斯河－阿爾貢攻勢自9月26日展開，第1軍清理了阿爾貢森林。賓州歷史標誌專文稱他採取冒險的側翼攻勢。
body.en: In September 1917 he was assigned to command the 41st Division and arrived in France on 6 October. On 20 January 1918 he took command of the 1st Army Corps, which fought in the Second Marne Campaign from 4 July to 13 August under the French 6th Army, then in the St. Mihiel Offensive, whose reduction began on 12 September and ended on 16 September. The Meuse-Argonne operation began on 26 September, and the corps cleared the Argonne Forest. A Pennsylvania marker article says his strategy was a risky flanking offensive.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年10月12日李傑特接掌美國遠征軍第1軍團，10月16日晉升中將；該軍團在11月1日至11日徹底突破敵軍抵抗線。1919年4月20日第1軍團解散後，他改任駐科布倫茨的第3軍團（萊茵占領軍）司令，至7月2日該軍團解散。他1921年3月21日以少將退役，1930年6月21日依法案追晉退役中將，1935年12月30日在舊金山去世。
body.en: Liggett took command of the First Army, A.E.F., on 12 October 1918 and was made lieutenant general on 16 October; it broke the enemy's line of resistance completely from 1 to 11 November. After the First Army was disbanded on 20 April 1919 he commanded the Third Army, the army of occupation on the Rhine at Coblenz, until it was disbanded on 2 July 1919. He retired as major general on 21 March 1921, was advanced to lieutenant general on the retired list on 21 June 1930, and died at San Francisco on 30 December 1935.
